**Anderson et al.'s conjecture.** For all $m$ and $n$,

$$
\frac{1}{13} \le \frac{\gamma_e^*(C_m \times C_n)}{mn}.
$$

Together with the known asymptotic upper bound $\lim_{m,n\to\infty}\gamma_e^*(C_m\times C_n)/(mn)\le 1/13$, this would establish $1/13$ as the asymptotic density. The source does not indicate that the conjecture has been resolved."

"Let $K^{(k)}_\ell$ be the $k$-uniform complete hypergraph on $\ell$ vertices, and let $R_n(K^{(k)}_\ell)$ denote the final number of edges in its removal process. **Bennett–Bohman folklore conjecture.** If $2\leq k<\ell$, then for every $\varepsilon>0$ there is $n_0\geq0$ such that, for every $n\geq n_0$, with high probability,

$$
n^{k-\frac{\ell-k}{\binom{\ell}{k}-1}-\varepsilon}\leq R_n(K^{(k)}_\ell)\leq n^{k-\frac{\ell-k}{\binom{\ell}{k}-1}+\varepsilon}.
$$

Beyond the triangle case, the paper reports no comparably close results for other forbidden hypergraphs and identifies asymptotic estimates for $R_n(K_4)$ as a central open problem."

$$
\operatorname{RG}(n,d) = \Big(\lambda^\lambda (1-\lambda)^{1-\lambda}\Big)^{\binom n2} \binom{n-1}{d}^{n} \exp\biggl(\,\sum_{j=1}^7 \frac{p_j(\varLambda)}{\varLambda^j n^{j-1}} + O\bigg(\frac{1}{d^3(n-d)^3n}\bigg)\biggr).
$$

This conjecture proposes a uniform approximation for the number of regular graphs across the full permitted degree range, improving earlier finite-term calculations and including an explicit error term."

"Let $F$ be a graph with $\operatorname{ex}(n,F)=\Theta(n^\alpha)$ for some $\alpha\in(1,2]$. Define the 2-density of a graph $F$ by

$$
m_2(F)=\max\left\{\frac{e(F')-1}{v(F')-2}:F'\subseteq F,\ e(F')\geq 2\right\},
$$

and let $G_{n,p}$ denote the binomial random graph. An event occurs **with high probability** when its probability tends to $1$ as $n$ tends to infinity.

**The random Turán conjecture.** With high probability,

$$
\operatorname{ex}(G_{n,p},F)=\begin{cases}\max\{\Theta(p^{\alpha-1}n^\alpha),n^{2-1/m_2(F)}(\log n)^{O(1)}\} & p\geq n^{-1/m_2(F)},\\ (1+o(1))p{n\choose 2} & n^{-1/m_2(F)}\gg p\gg n^{-2}.
\end{cases}
$$

Equivalently,

$$
\operatorname{ex}(G_{n,p},F)=\begin{cases}\Theta(p^{\alpha-1}n^\alpha) & p\geq n^{\frac{2-\alpha-1/m_2(F)}{\alpha-1}}(\log n)^{O(1)},\\ n^{2-1/m_2(F)}(\log n)^{O(1)} & n^{\frac{2-\alpha-1/m_2(F)}{\alpha-1}}(\log n)^{O(1)}\geq p\geq n^{-1/m_2(F)},\\ (1+o(1))p{n\choose 2} & n^{-1/m_2(F)}\gg p\gg n^{-2}.
\end{cases}
$$

This conjecture predicts two phase transitions for the random Turán problem for bipartite graphs: one near $p=n^{-1/m_2(F)}$ and another near $p=n^{(2-\alpha-1/m_2(F))/(\alpha-1)}$, up to polylogarithmic factors. "Let $K_{m,n}$ be the complete bipartite graph with parts of sizes $m$ and $n$, and let $R(m,n;\lambda_0,\ldots,\lambda_k)$ count partitions of its edges into spanning semiregular subgraphs with densities $\lambda_0,\ldots,\lambda_k$. For positive numbers $\lambda_0,\ldots,\lambda_k$ satisfying

$$
\sum_{i=0}^k\lambda_i=1,
$$

write $\binom{a}{a_0,\ldots,a_k}$ for a multinomial coefficient and define

$$
R'(m,n;\lambda_0,\ldots,\lambda_k)=\frac{\displaystyle\binom{n}{\lambda_0 n,\ldots,\lambda_k n}^{\!m}\binom{m}{\lambda_0 m,\ldots,\lambda_k m}^{\!n}}{\displaystyle\binom{mn}{\lambda_0 mn,\ldots,\lambda_k mn}}(1-1/m)^{k(m-1)/2}.
$$

**The multipartite semiregular factorisation conjecture.** If $n\to\infty$ with $2\le m\le n$ and $1\le k=o(m)$, then

$$
R(m,n;\lambda_0,\ldots,\lambda_k)\sim R'(m,n;\lambda_0,\ldots,\lambda_k).
$$

This generalises the known asymptotic formula for decompositions into two spanning semiregular subgraphs. The paper proves the conjecture in several regimes, including fixed $m$, sparse cases, nearly equal densities, and the Latin-rectangle case, but leaves the full range $1\le k=o(m)$ open."
